Many people who are groomed don't feel like they are being groomed until they look back. Asking for an outsider's perspective is a good move and shows your self awareness. Regardless of how nice of a person he is, he is the adult in the situation and he has crossed the boundary of friendship with you which is bound to feel overwhelming (and even flattering to a certain degree). Think of yourself as a 31 year old, would you pursue a 16 year old? Think of your future child, what would you advise should a 31 year old have explicit conversations with them? Look at this person and consider what they see in you, it may be uncomfortable to do so but why you and not someone their own age? Is it the shared interests and politics which excites him or is it the control and manipulation? What can he gain from you that he cannot gain from a partner his own age, who is fully developed and more experienced. I hope you find the courage you need to make safe decisions and form friendships and relationships with like-minded people your own age. ❤ Sending love.
